english.name: Sweden Hunting Licence Theory Test (Jägarexamen)
english.fullName: Swedish hunting licence theory test (jägarexamen, teoriprov), in Swedish

notes: Three real-length tests of 70 = 210 items, every item in exactly one test (pools exactly 3x each per-test count). passPct 85 = ceil(0.85 x 70) = 60 of 70, the real pass line (NFS 2015:10 13 a §). Categories group the 16 areas of Naturvårdsverket's kompetensbeskrivning (2020); the 12/12/10/10/8/7/6/5 split is Tigertest's own (no published weights). Five topic sets 23401-23405 (36, 36, 60, 45, 33) + 3 tests = 8 dashboard steps. Icon key: check which icon hunter uses and reuse it.
